items.exampleEn: The kitten tangled itself in a ball of wool.
items.exampleZh: 小貓被一團毛線纏住了。

items.exampleEn: Few people willingly relinquish a comfortable habit.
items.exampleZh: 很少人會心甘情願地放棄一個舒服的習慣。

items.exampleEn: Strange noises at night unsettle our old dog.
items.exampleZh: 夜裡奇怪的聲音會讓我們家的老狗不安。

items.exampleEn: Her whole body stiffened when she heard steps behind her.
items.exampleZh: 聽到身後有腳步聲，她全身僵住了。

items.exampleEn: The heat fused the two pieces of metal together.
items.exampleZh: 高溫把兩塊金屬熔合在一起。

items.exampleEn: The wind wrenched the umbrella out of my hand.
items.exampleZh: 風猛地把傘從我手中扯走。

items.exampleEn: Little can be gleaned from such a short report.
items.exampleZh: 從這麼短的報告中，很難蒐集到什麼資訊。

items.exampleEn: The actor's rendering of the old king was praised by critics.
items.exampleZh: 那位演員對老國王一角的詮釋獲得影評人讚揚。

items.sentenceEn: The mixture will stiffen as it cools overnight.
items.sentenceZh: 這團混合物放一夜冷卻後就會變硬。

items.audioEn: The sudden change in the schedule unsettled the whole team for days.
items.audioZh: 行程突然改變，讓整個團隊好幾天都心神不寧。
items.questionZh: 行程突然改變對團隊有什麼影響？
options: It let the team leave work early on Friday.
It made the team feel uneasy.

items.sentenceEn: He wrenched the steering wheel to the left to miss the cat.
items.sentenceZh: 他猛地把方向盤往左轉，避開那隻貓。

items.sentenceEn: I gleaned most of my local knowledge from the taxi drivers.
items.sentenceZh: 我對當地的了解，大多是從計程車司機那裡一點一點聽來的。

items.stemEn: The two companies plan to ____ their research teams into one larger group.
items.stemZh: 這兩家公司打算把各自的研究團隊合併成一個更大的團隊。

items.stemEn: My headphone cables always get ____ at the bottom of my bag.
items.stemZh: 我的耳機線在包包底部總是會纏在一起。

items.passageEn: After forty years, Mr. Ho finally relinquished control of his furniture workshop to his daughter, Mei. On her first day, she had to wrench open a drawer that had been stuck for years. Inside, under a tangle of old string, she found her father's notebooks. Over the next few months, she gleaned many useful tips from them. Mei wanted to fuse her father's traditional designs with a cleaner, modern style, and at first the idea unsettled some loyal customers. However, when she showed them a rendering of a new chair, most of them changed their minds. Her father simply smiled and said the design looked robust enough.
items.passageZh: 經營四十年後，何先生終於把家具工作坊交給女兒 Mei 掌管。上工第一天，她得用力扭開一個卡了好幾年的抽屜。裡面，在一團纏在一起的舊繩子底下，她找到了父親的筆記本。接下來幾個月，她從筆記本裡一點一滴學到許多實用的技巧。Mei 想把父親的傳統設計和更簡潔的現代風格融合在一起，起初這個想法讓一些老顧客感到不安。不過，當她給他們看一張新椅子的示意圖後，大多數人都改變了想法。她父親只是笑著說，這個設計看起來夠堅固。

questions.questionZh: Mei 在抽屜裡找到什麼？
顧客看到什麼之後，大多改變了想法？
options: 比以前便宜很多的價目表
工作坊重新裝潢後的樣子
父親親手做的一張舊桌子

items.promptZh: 經過一番討論，她同意讓出那個靠窗的座位。
referenceEn: After some discussion, she agreed to relinquish the window seat.
She agreed to relinquish her window seat after a short discussion.
rubricZh: 「讓出、放棄」用 relinquish，後面直接接名詞（例如 relinquish the window seat）
「同意做某事」可寫，例如 agreed to、was willing to 等
「經過一番討論」可寫，例如 after some discussion、after a short talk 等，放句首或句尾都可以

items.promptZh: 建築師給我們看了新圖書館的電腦示意圖。
referenceEn: The architect showed us a computer rendering of the new library.
We were shown a computer rendering of the new library by the architect.
rubricZh: 「示意圖」用 rendering（例如 a computer rendering of the new library 等）
時態配合內容（例如 showed、were shown 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（rendering）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u36-l02-q17；目標字沿用 rendering
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「建築師給我們看了新圖書館的電腦示意圖。」、hintWords ["rendering"]、referenceEn ["The architect showed us a computer rendering of the new library.","We were shown a computer rendering of the new library by the architect."]、rubricZh ["「示意圖」用 rendering（例如 a computer rendering of the new library 等）","時態配合內容（例如 showed、were shown 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 rendering 造一個句子，說說你聽過或看過的某個演出或改編版本。」、referenceEn ["I loved the band's rendering of an old folk song.","I once heard a slow piano rendering of my favorite pop song."]）
